instrument: Office of the Governor of Oregon, statement supporting local data center moratoriums, August 7, 2026
summary: Governor Kotek supports locally-set moratoriums on new data center development until DCAC recommendations are reviewed and the legislature considers a new statutory framework, stating the state lacks authority to enact a statewide moratorium. Same announcement: termination of the state's sale of about 32 acres at Mill Creek Corporate Center, Salem.
text: Governor Tina Kotek announced today that she supports locally-set moratoriums on new data center development until the findings and recommendations from the Oregon Data Center Advisory Committee can be reviewed and a new statutory framework can be considered by the legislature next year. While the state lacks authority to enact a statewide moratorium, Governor Kotek supports local communities taking action.

source.citation: Oregon Newsroom, Office of the Governor, Governor Kotek Supports Moratoriums on Data Center Development, August 7, 2026

notes: A statement of position, not an instrument. The Governor later (September 2026) called for the legislature to pass a statewide moratorium in the 2027 session; a three-year statewide moratorium bill is proposed by legislators for that session.
